mainTopic: Whether the days a נזיר spends as a מצורע count toward his נזירות: רב שרביה's proof from a משנה and his own answer, followed by the start of a new objection from רמי בר חמא.
overview: The גמרא is checking whether the days a נזיר spends as a confirmed מצורע count toward his נזירות. First it finishes a proof from a משנה that says that after his צרעת shaving the נזיר 'starts counting immediately'. A short נזירות doesn't fit that wording, so the גמרא argues the משנה must be about a long נזירות. That would suggest the צרעת days are lost. רב שרביה, who brought this proof himself, then turns it back. He reads the משנה as a fifty-day נזירות in which the נזיר got צרעת after twenty days. The thirty days he still has left give him the hair growth he needs, so the משנה proves nothing. Finally, רמי בר חמא starts a new challenge from another משנה, about a נזיר whose טומאה and whose status as a confirmed מצורע are both uncertain. That quote continues on the next amud.

steps.title: The משנה must be about a long נזירות, yet he starts counting right away
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא concludes that the משנה must be speaking about a long נזירות. Since the משנה still says he 'starts counting immediately', this seems to show that his days as a מצורע were not counted toward his נזירות.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, isn't the משנה talking about a long נזירות? And still it teaches that he starts counting right away!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes its proof. A short נזירות doesn't fit the משנה, so the משנה must mean a long נזירות. Even there it says he 'starts counting', which points to the צרעת days not counting.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A short (30-day) נזירות doesn't fit the משנה's wording, because the נזיר needs 30 days of hair growth. So the גמרא pushes the case into a long נזירות. If his צרעת days had counted, he would not need to 'start counting' anew. The phrase 'starts counting immediately' therefore seems to say that those days are lost.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather, isn't it so that... (introduces the conclusion the גמרא is pushing toward)
A long נזירות, longer than the standard thirty days

phrases.english: Rather, is it not about a lengthy naziriteship,
and it teaches: he starts counting immediately!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes a proof that began before this section, using the משנה about a נזיר who became a מצורע.
steps.kashyaTarget: The possibility that a מצורע's days count toward his נזירות.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: In a long נזירות the משנה still says he 'starts counting'. That implies the צרעת days did not count.

steps.title: A fifty-day נזירות explains the משנה
steps.stepSummary: רב שרביה answers his own objection. The משנה can be about a fifty-day נזירות: the נזיר kept twenty days and then got צרעת. After his צרעת shaving he still has thirty נזיר days left, and those thirty days give him the hair growth he needs.
steps.simpleTranslation: He asked it and he answered it. The case is a fifty-day נזירות. He kept twenty days and then got צרעת. He shaves for his צרעת, then sits thirty more נזיר days, which gives him enough hair growth.
steps.whatsHappening: The same רב שרביה who raised the objection now answers it. He gives a specific case that fits the משנה's words without proving the צרעת days are lost.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The problem with a short נזירות was that the hair would not have 30 days to grow. In a fifty-day נזירות interrupted after twenty days, thirty days remain, and those cover the hair growth. So 'starts counting immediately' just means he picks up his remaining thirty days. The משנה no longer proves what the objection wanted.

keyTerms.term: הוּא מוֹתֵיב לַהּ וְהוּא מְפָרֵק לַהּ
keyTerms.meaning: He himself raised the objection and he himself resolved it
The skin disease of the Torah; someone who has it is a מצורע
Hair growth; a נזיר needs 30 days of growth before his final shaving

steps.whatToRemember: 'Starts counting immediately' can fit a fifty-day נזירות where thirty days are left after the צרעת shaving. So the משנה does not prove that the צרעת days are lost.

phrases.aramaic: הוּא מוֹתֵיב לַהּ וְהוּא מְפָרֵק לַהּ:
phrases.english: He raised the objection and he resolved it:
phrases.notes: 'He' is רב שרביה, the one who asked the question in the first place.

phrases.english: about a naziriteship of fifty days,

phrases.notes: 'Sat' means he kept his נזירות for those days.

phrases.english: and he again sits thirty days as a nazirite.
For he does have hair growth.

steps.triggerLanguage: הוּא מוֹתֵיב לַהּ וְהוּא מְפָרֵק לַהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof in step 1 by reading the משנה as a fifty-day נזירות, so the משנה no longer settles whether the צרעת days count.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Recasting the case (אוקימתא) as a specific fifty-day נזירות
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה had to be about a long נזירות in which the צרעת days were lost.
steps.terutzMaskana: In a fifty-day נזירות, the remaining thirty days give him hair growth, so the משנה proves nothing about whether the צרעת days count.

steps.title: רמי בר חמא begins a new objection from a משנה about doubtful status
steps.stepSummary: רמי בר חמא starts a new challenge. He quotes a משנה about a נזיר whose טומאה is uncertain and whose status as a confirmed מצורע is also uncertain.
steps.simpleTranslation: רמי בר חמא objected: a נזיר who was possibly טמא, and possibly a confirmed מצורע...
steps.whatsHappening: This is a setup line. רמי בר חמא is opening a new objection by quoting a משנה, and the quote continues past this point.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The new source is about a נזיר in double doubt: maybe he became טמא from a dead body, and maybe he is a confirmed מצורע. Here we only see the opening of the quote. The actual challenge comes once the משנה is finished.

keyTerms.meaning: Possibly טמא; his טומאה is uncertain
A confirmed מצורע, as opposed to one only quarantined

steps.confusionAlert: This step is not complete. The quote breaks off in the middle, and the point of the objection comes on the next amud.

phrases.english: Rami bar Ḥama raised an objection:
A nazirite who was impure with uncertainty,
phrases.notes: This means it's unclear whether he became טמא from a dead body.

phrases.english: and a confirmed leper with uncertainty,

steps.kashyaTarget: רב שרביה's open question about whether a מצורע's days count toward his נזירות. The new משנה is brought to bear on that question.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Not yet stated on this amud. The quoted משנה about doubtful טומאה and doubtful צרעת continues on the next amud.
